Kit summary

Soul BlowBasic
Deal 160% ATK DMG to an enemy and another 2 random enemies, with a 50% chance to inflict 1 layer of [Inferior Severe Wound] for 2 turns. If there is only one enemy left, deals 320% ATK DMG, with a 100% chance to inflict a layer of [Inferior Severe Wound] for 2 turns.
Totem of FearActive
Deals 120% ATK DMG to all enemies, with a 90% chance to inflict a layer of [Horrify] for 1 turn.
Soul ConnectionPassiveExclusive Lv.2
Inflicts [HP Connection] on the enemy with the highest ATK at the beginning of each wave, and deals DMG by 50% of the DMG taken by Nasakhma to the target. When a target Nasakhma inflicted [HP Connection] on dies, Nasakhma restores self HP by 25% of Max HP. Meanwhile, he inflicts [HP Connection] on the enemy with the highest ATK before the next turn starts. [HP Connection] inflicted by Nasakhma cannot be cleansed.
Soul Lantern Lv.2The enemy bound to [HP Connection] receives 15% more DMG.
Imperious CurseActiveExclusive Lv.1 · Lv.3
Deals 260% ATK DMG to all enemies and steals all their buffs and resets their duration.
Soul Lantern Lv.1Resets the cooldown of Imperious Curse when an enemy target who does not have a buff or is under [Horrify] status dies.
Soul Lantern Lv.3After Imperious Curse successfully steals buffs, there is an 60% chance to inflict [Horrify] for 1 turn on the target whose buffs have been stolen.
